name: dnbg-agent-summaries
description: Keep the summary files agents write (research, design proposals, issue drafts) in one directory with a status field, and sweep the stale ones into an archive. No hooks, no forge.

data_dir.title: Where dnbg keeps its files
data_dir.description: Directory the summary directory sits under, as agent-summaries/, unless that is set on its own. Must be an absolute path or one under '~/', using only letters, digits and '. _ - /'; anything else is ignored and the default used instead. Leave empty for '~/.claude/dnbg'.

summary_dir.title: Where summary files are written
summary_dir.description: Directory agents write summary files in, one Markdown file per topic with no per-repo subdirectories; summary-review sweeps stale ones into its archive/ subdirectory. Must be an absolute path or one under '~/', using only letters, digits and '. _ - /'; anything else is ignored and '<data directory>/agent-summaries' used instead, as it is when left empty.
